Title: Azure SQL Edge now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure SQL Edge meets the demands of IoT edge data and compute with built-in streaming, storage, and AI—all backed by the industry-leading performance and security of SQL. Now available in preview, Azure SQL Edge is a small-footprint container (less than 500 mb) running in ARM- and x64-based devices in connected, disconnected, or semi-connected environments where speed, agility, and analytics are important. While in preview, transact SQL Edge at no cost in regions where Azure IoT Edge is available.

Download the preview and get started today.
